# Define capital facts
capital_Denmark_Copenhagen = True
capital_Azerbaijan_Baku = True
capital_Cameroon_Douala = True
capital_Norway_Bergen = False  # Actually Oslo
capital_Colombia_Bogota = True
capital_UAE_Abu_Dhabi = True
capital_UAE_Dubai = False
capital_Belarus_Minsk = True

# Expression A
expr_a = (not not not (
    (not not (not (5 * -8 > 10) or (-8 - (-3 / -5) <= -6))) 
    or 
    (not not not (
        (not not not (max(-6, -5, -8, -5) - min(-6, -5, -8, -5) <= 7)) 
        and 
        (not not (7 - (-9 / -9) <= 3))
    ))
) 
and 
(not not (
    (not (
        (not not (False)) 
        or 
        (not not not (max(4, -2, 5, -2) - min(4, -2, 5, -2) > 4))
    )) 
    or 
    ((not (max(8, -2, -6, -8) - min(8, -2, -6, -8) <= 10)) or (False))
))))

# Expression B
expr_b = (not not ((not not not (-6 * -1 > 1) and not not (4 * 7 + 5 * 2 <= 10 * -1)) 
                   or 
                   (not not not capital_Denmark_Copenhagen and not not (True)))
          or
          not not not (not not (not capital_Azerbaijan_Baku and (-3 - (8 / -4) > 10)) 
                       or 
                       not not not (not not (-4 * 5 > 5) 
                                    or 
                                    not not not (max(-4, -3, -7, 3) - min(-4, -3, -7, 3) > 7))))

# Expression C
expr_c = (not not not (
    (not not (
        (not (-5 * -1 + -1 * 5 <= -1 * 3) or (9 * -6 + -10 * 3 > 9 * -5)) 
        or 
        (not not capital_Cameroon_Douala or not not not (-4 * 3 + 2 * -6 <= -10 * 3))
    )) 
    or 
    not not not (
        (not not (not not capital_Norway_Bergen or not not not (3 * 3 <= 1))) 
        or 
        not not not ((-4 * 4 + 8 * -4 <= -4 * 8) and (6 - (3 / -9) <= 3))
    )
) 
and 
(not not (
    (not not not (
        (not not not (not not not (-3 - (9 / -5) > -6) and not not (9 - (4 / 6) <= -1))) 
        and 
        not not (not (8 * -5 + -5 * -6 > 8 * 8) and (True))
    )) 
    and 
    not not (
        (not capital_Colombia_Bogota or (True)) 
        and 
        (not (-1 * 6 + -10 * -5 > -10 * -9) and (-9 * -9 > -9))
    )
)))

# Expression D
expr_d = (not not (
    not ((4 * -8 > -4) and (-6 * -5 > -8)) 
    and 
    (not (True) or (6 * 8 + -5 * -2 > -8 * -1))
)
or
not not not (
    (not not (not not not (max(-6, 6, 4, -7) - min(-6, 6, 4, -7) > 4) and not not capital_UAE_Abu_Dhabi)) 
    or 
    not not not (not (2 * -10 > -1) and capital_UAE_Dubai)
))

# Expression E
expr_e = (not (
    (not (
        not not (max(-2, 1, -8, 10) - min(-2, 1, -8, 10) > 5) 
        or 
        not not not (4 * -10 + -9 * -9 > -5 * -7)
    )) 
    or 
    (not (-5 * 7 > 1) or capital_Belarus_Minsk)
)
or
(
    (not not (max(4, -4, 4, 8) - min(4, -4, 4, 8) > 1) or not not not (False)) 
    and 
    ((8 - (-3 / -3) > -10) and (False))
))

print(f"A: {expr_a}")
print(f"B: {expr_b}")
print(f"C: {expr_c}")
print(f"D: {expr_d}")
print(f"E: {expr_e}")

# Count true values
results = {'A': expr_a, 'B': expr_b, 'C': expr_c, 'D': expr_d, 'E': expr_e}
true_count = sum(1 for v in results.values() if v)
true_letter = [k for k, v in results.items() if v]

print(f"\nTotal true expressions: {true_count}")
print(f"True expression(s): {true_letter}")
EOF

# Verify Expression B step by step
print("Expression B detailed breakdown:")
print()

# Part 1 of the OR
print("Part 1: not not ((not not not (-6 * -1 > 1) and not not (4 * 7 + 5 * 2 <= 10 * -1)) or (not not not True and not not True))")

step1 = -6 * -1 > 1

step3 = 4 * 7 + 5 * 2 <= 10 * -1

step7 = not not True

step8 = step6 and step7

step9 = step5 or step8
print(f"  {step5} or {step8} = {step9}")

part1 = not not step9
print(f"  not not {step9} = {part1}")

# Part 2 of the OR
print("Part 2: not not not (not not (not True and (-3 - (8 / -4) > 10)) or not not not (not not (-4 * 5 > 5) or not not not (max(-4, -3, -7, 3) - min(-4, -3, -7, 3) > 7)))")

step10 = not True
print(f"  not True = {step10}")
step11 = -3 - (8 / -4) > 10
print(f"  -3 - (8 / -4) = {-3 - (8 / -4)}, > 10: {step11}")
step12 = step10 and step11
print(f"  {step10} and {step11} = {step12}")
step13 = not not step12
print(f"  not not {step12} = {step13}")

step14 = -4 * 5 > 5
print(f"  -4 * 5 > 5 = {step14}")
step15 = not not step14
print(f"  not not {step14} = {step15}")

step16 = max(-4, -3, -7, 3) - min(-4, -3, -7, 3) > 7
print(f"  max(-4, -3, -7, 3) = {max(-4, -3, -7, 3)}, min = {min(-4, -3, -7, 3)}, diff = {max(-4, -3, -7, 3) - min(-4, -3, -7, 3)}, > 7: {step16}")
step17 = not not not step16
print(f"  not not not {step16} = {step17}")

step18 = step15 or step17
print(f"  {step15} or {step17} = {step18}")
step19 = not not not step18
print(f"  not not not {step18} = {step19}")

step20 = step13 or step19
print(f"  {step13} or {step19} = {step20}")
part2 = not not not step20
print(f"  not not not {step20} = {part2}")
print()

# Final OR

print(f"Final result: {part1} or {part2} = {result}")
